status: registered test at level 0.01, one-sided (D > 0); exact relabelling within seed pairs, 1,024 distinct partitions, floor 1/1024. Descriptive items as registered; diagnostics not pre-specified are labelled as such
file_names_note: Entry 116 names src/fv/fv_weights_invert.py -> out/fv_weights_invert.json; this run was instructed to write src/fv/fv_weights_inv.py -> out/fv_weights_inv.json. Names only.

settings.relabelling: labels of N_j and I_j kept or exchanged independently for each body and seed j
settings.extraction: dW = B A per layer; cosine of concatenated dW via h5_weight_signature.gram (exact)

primary.statistic: D = (D_A + D_B)/2; D_X = mean cosine over the 30 within-condition different-seed pairs (15 N-N, 15 I-I) - mean cosine over the 30 cross-condition different-seed pairs; seeds 0-5; same-seed pairs and inverted seeds 6-7 excluded
primary.null_1024_order: index = 32 * a + b; a, b index the 32 distinct relabellings of body A, B (product order of the six swap bits with seed 0 kept, identity first)
primary.reading: the adapter weights carry the fingerprint's sign
primary.reading_scope: in the precise sense that they distinguish training on the photographs with the fingerprint reversed from training on the same photographs unchanged: a white-box trace of the stored fingerprint change. The two conditions also differ by the fixed dither field and by training date, so a positive result does not isolate the fingerprint pattern from the dither. It says nothing about whether a natural-amplitude fingerprint is recoverable from standard 2000-step adapters. The date is not expected to matter: among different-seed pairs, batches ten days apart differ by -0.0001 (Entry 114); cited, not tested.

matched_variant.definition: Delta_j = dW(I_j) - dW(N_j); statistic = mean over the 15 within-body pairs j<k of cos(Delta_j, Delta_k), averaged over the two bodies (= mean over 30 pairs); exchanging seed pair j flips the sign of Delta_j; 1,024 distinct relabellings

seeds_6_7_kept.definition: inverted seeds 6-7 always labelled inverted; within = pooled mean over the 43 same-label different-seed pairs (15 N-N + 28 I-I), cross = pooled mean over the 42 different-label different-seed pairs; 64 relabellings per body, 4,096 over both

2_shared_stream_from_training_logs.what: Pearson r of the first differences of the 80 logged 200-step mean losses; twins share seed j, so the same batch order, noise and timesteps; offset = inverted minus normal
